definitions.ask: Should named dismissed-bundle lookups report the bundle path under the caller's root instead of its canonical form?
definitions.why: Other store reads return the stored caller-rooted key, and the feature's own tests expect it

choices.label: Core returns caller-rooted paths from index and fallback hits; existing assertions stay as-is
Keep canonical output; rewrite 8 Rust/Py assertions to expect canonicalized paths

definitions.ask: Should the CI test step run with --no-fail-fast so one failing test binary cannot hide failures in later binaries?
definitions.why: cargo stopped at sase_core's lib tests and hid a 9th macOS failure in sase_core_py

choices.label: Add --no-fail-fast to the CI test step only; red runs list every binary's failures
Leave CI as-is; a masked failure surfaces only after the one ahead of it is fixed

definitions.ask: Should sase-core's AGENTS.md macOS bullet gain a Linux repro recipe that uses a symlinked TMPDIR?
definitions.why: The repro turns a macOS-only CI round trip into a local test run of under a minute

choices.label: Extend the existing canonicalization bullet with the TMPDIR-through-a-symlink repro command
